content: Discourse: /latest.json is public only when the instance does not set login_required — login-required sites redirect/403 anonymous JSON requests; per-instance rate limits (DISCOURSE_MAX_REQS_PER_MINUTE etc.) vary by operator and return 429 WITH a Retry-After header; pagination is via topic_list.more_topics_url (relative URL, must append .json) rather than a uniform page param across versions; anonymous traffic shares an IP bucket.
